note: The parts a skiff (AC-01.1) is painted in by scripts/paint_parts.py, found by scripts/label_parts.py. base: the part every unclaimed face belongs to; here the hull, which keeps the struts and iron straps (the detector finds those unreliably, and they paint well with the hull). prompts: the phrases the detector is asked for that part. max_box: the largest share of the model's own box in a picture that part's box may take (a small part's phrase also matches the whole boat). threshold: the detector's score floor. together: paint every piece of the part as one, from a picture of all of them (the two fins; painted apart, one came back pale and one marked). colour: the part's colour in the review views.
